name: 重生的世界 (Revival World)
english_description: RWlib v1.0.1, a life-simulation and city-management MUD developed by a Taiwanese team — an entirely independent, self-built engine unrelated to this collection's wuxia-themed mudlibs. Rather than combat and leveling, it centers on farming, fishing, animal husbandry, running factories, real-estate trading, stock speculation, and mahjong, backed by a full system of city mayors, taxation, and enterprises; new characters can settle in a city (currently just one, the 'Abandoned City') to build a livelihood there.
